title: Loan application review
description: Review wallet-submitted loan applications, supporting PDFs, verifiable credentials and cryptographic proofs.

stages.title: Identity and eligibility
stages.description: Check applicant identity, purpose and eligibility signals.

stages.title: Affordability and income
stages.description: Validate income evidence, affordability and repayment capacity.

stages.title: Decision and funding
stages.description: Record decision, conditions and disbursement path.

evidenceRequirements.title: Income or supporting PDF
evidenceRequirements.description: Proof of income, bank statements or related application pack.

evidenceRequirements.title: Wallet proof
evidenceRequirements.description: Cryptographic proof of request origin or possession.

title: Account opening review
description: Review wallet-submitted onboarding packs for new accounts, deposits, cards and identity evidence.

stages.title: KYC verification
stages.description: Validate identity, address and customer screening results.

stages.title: Funding source
stages.description: Confirm source of funds and initial account funding details.

stages.title: Activation and servicing
stages.description: Approve account opening, product issuance and customer activation.

title: KYC refresh review
description: Review periodic KYC refreshes, documentary updates and wallet attestation proofs.

stages.title: Identity refresh
stages.description: Check the updated identity and address signals.

stages.title: Screening and risk
stages.description: Assess sanctions, PEP and adverse media changes.

stages.title: Refresh closure
stages.description: Approve refresh completion or refer for manual review.

title: Insurance underwriting review
description: Review wallet-submitted underwriting requests, schedules and digital proofs for policy decisions.

stages.title: Policy and coverage
stages.description: Validate requested coverage, policy terms and exclusions.

stages.title: Risk assessment
stages.description: Assess exposure, history and supporting evidence.

stages.title: Bind or refer
stages.description: Issue, refer or decline the underwriting request.

evidenceRequirements.title: Policy schedule PDF
evidenceRequirements.description: Quoted schedule, declaration or supporting document.

evidenceRequirements.title: Identity or business credential
evidenceRequirements.description: Wallet-issued credential for the insured party.

evidenceRequirements.title: Wallet proof
evidenceRequirements.description: Cryptographic proof of the submitted request.

title: Credit limit increase review
description: Review wallet-submitted credit line increase requests with affordability and conduct evidence.

stages.title: Conduct and behaviour
stages.description: Review repayment history, utilisation and account conduct.

stages.title: Affordability update
stages.description: Validate current income, obligations and affordability.

stages.title: Limit decision
stages.description: Approve, refer or decline the limit increase.

title: Loan top-up review
description: Review top-up requests for existing borrowers using refreshed affordability and wallet evidence.

stages.title: Repayment history
stages.description: Review existing performance and repayment conduct.

stages.title: Updated affordability
stages.description: Validate current income and obligations.

stages.title: Top-up decision
stages.description: Approve, refer or decline the additional funding.

title: Merchant onboarding review
description: Review merchant onboarding packs, registrations and wallet-submitted control evidence.

stages.title: Business validation
stages.description: Check registration, tax and operating evidence.

stages.title: Merchant risk
stages.description: Assess products, channels and merchant risk.

stages.title: Merchant activation
stages.description: Approve acceptance, limits and settlement path.

evidenceRequirements.title: Registration PDF
evidenceRequirements.description: Business registration, tax or certificate evidence.

evidenceRequirements.title: Business credential
evidenceRequirements.description: Verifiable business or beneficial ownership credential.

title: Card issuance review
description: Review wallet-submitted card issuance requests and delivery controls.

stages.title: KYC and eligibility
stages.description: Check identity, limits and card eligibility.

stages.title: Delivery controls
stages.description: Validate delivery address and activation controls.

stages.title: Issue card
stages.description: Approve issuance, activation and fulfilment.

title: Corporate onboarding review
description: Review SME and corporate onboarding packs with ownership, authority and wallet evidence.

stages.title: Entity verification
stages.description: Check registration, structure and operating profile.

stages.title: Authority and ownership
stages.description: Verify signatory authority and beneficial ownership.

stages.title: Onboarding decision
stages.description: Approve, refer or reject the application.

title: Mortgage review
description: Review mortgage origination packs, valuation evidence and applicant credentials.

stages.title: Property and valuation
stages.description: Validate property, valuation and collateral evidence.

stages.title: Income and affordability
stages.description: Review affordability, deposit and repayment capacity.

stages.title: Mortgage approval
stages.description: Approve, conditionally approve or refer.

title: SME onboarding review
description: Review SME onboarding packs, ownership evidence and wallet-submitted controls.

stages.title: Entity verification
stages.description: Check registration, beneficial ownership and tax status.

stages.title: Operations and risk
stages.description: Assess operations, products and risk profile.

stages.title: Onboarding decision
stages.description: Approve, refer or reject the request.

title: Deposit opening review
description: Review deposit product applications, identity evidence and wallet attestations.

stages.title: Identity review
stages.description: Check identity, address and product eligibility.

stages.title: Funding and terms
stages.description: Review funding source and product conditions.

stages.title: Account activation
stages.description: Approve deposit opening and service activation.

evidenceRequirements.title: Address PDF
evidenceRequirements.description: Proof of address or supporting account document.

title: Trade finance review
description: Review trade finance applications, documentary evidence and counterparty proofs.

stages.title: Document verification
stages.description: Check invoices, shipping and documentary requirements.

stages.title: Counterparty review
stages.description: Validate counterparties, sanctions and route.

stages.title: Trade decision
stages.description: Approve, amend or escalate the transaction.

evidenceRequirements.title: Trade document PDF
evidenceRequirements.description: Invoice, bill of lading or contract document.
